_integration_status: Reviewed content draft, not activated in problems.json. Activation requires #31, #38 and #41/#48; clinical-priority entry before confirmation requires owner integration.

w_intro.text: Your vision readings need follow-up in each eye separately. This app guides you; it does not diagnose.
w_intro.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch [P]

w_red_flags.text: Do you have any of these right now, in either eye: a new gap in your visual field, distortion in the centre of your vision, a need for stronger correction than you have, sudden vision loss, or intense eye pain or headache with neurological signs?
w_red_flags.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; SANS consensus, 2026 [6]; Team triage guide [P]

w_notify.text: Notify the crew medical officer. Together, agree on your check-ups and who is responsible for them.
w_notify.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: initial action [P]

w_acuity.text: Measure corrected visual acuity in each eye and compare it with the personal baseline. Review OCT and visual-field tests when available.
w_acuity.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: initial action [P]

w_correction.text: Use the prescribed optical correction for focusing difficulties. Better focus does not prove that swelling has resolved.
w_correction.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; SANS consensus, 2026 [6]

w_habitat.text: Review your sleep and the habitat conditions, following their procedures.
w_habitat.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, watch: management [P]

w_limits.text: Do not start lower body negative pressure, thigh cuffs, supplements or any eye procedure from this app. These countermeasures are still being researched and are not automatic treatments for an alert.

w_end.text: Keep the check-ups agreed with your clinician. A concerning eye finding needs priority review even without symptoms.
w_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5]; Team triage guide [P]

u_stop.text: Stop risky tasks and EVA, and alert the crew medical officer immediately. Record when symptoms began and which eye is affected; do not wait for OCT.
u_stop.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS, medical urgency: initial action [P]

u_orbit.text: Send the case to the flight surgeons. Continue local medical care while awaiting their advice.
u_orbit.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred.

u_moon.text: Send the case to the flight surgeons. Continue local medical care while awaiting their advice.
u_moon.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred.

u_mars_send.text: Send the case to Earth and continue local medical care. A delayed Earth reply must not delay local assessment.
u_mars_send.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred.

u_ground.text: Send the case to the flight surgeons. Continue local medical care while awaiting their advice.
u_ground.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; stop/medical-assessment response [P]; communication context: https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf . No SANS evacuation rule is inferred.

u_end.text: Clinical review and handover have been acknowledged. Follow medical restrictions; this app neither prescribes medicines nor authorizes EVA.
u_end.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; Team triage guide, SANS: implementation and closing rules [P]

u_help.text: Request immediate assistance from the crew medical officer. Do not continue the risky task.

u_reviewed.text: Has a clinician reviewed this episode and accepted the handover?
u_reviewed.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; keep urgency active until clinical review [P]. Prototype acknowledgement, not identity verification.

u_wait_review.text: Stay assisted and continue the local medical instructions. Keep this episode open until clinical review and accepted handover.
u_wait_review.source: guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2; clinical review before closure [P]. No timed wait is prescribed.
